title: Citation share
content: Citation share is the proportion of counted source citations that belong to a specified page or domain within a sample.

meta.why: Citation share shows how much of the cited-source pool belongs to you, and it can stay small while your citation rate looks healthy.
meta.example: If your domain accounts for 6 of 40 counted domain citations, its share is 15%, even if it appeared in 30% of the sampled answers.
meta.check: Choose a counting unit, such as one citation per domain per answer, and use that same unit in both parts of the calculation.
meta.limitation: Adding competitors or changing how duplicates count changes the denominator. Label the method beside the number.
meta.sources: Ahrefs: AI visibility metrics | https://help.ahrefs.com/en/articles/15501968-ai-visibility-metrics | Vendor documentation
